data.title: Ero Copper Temporarily Suspends Tucumã Production Activities
data.description:
An announcement from Ero Copper ( (TSE:ERO) ) is now available.

SEMAS directed Ero to temporarily suspend mining at Tucumã after intense rainfall caused two localized contact-water overflow events. The company then suspended all mining and processing activities, while adding pumping and storage resources and relocating a stockpile after notifying the regulator.

SEMAS said its assessment found anomalous pH readings in local water samples, and requested a final remediation plan for review while dialogue with Ero remains ongoing. Fines tied to the overflows totalled approximately US$2.9 million, while Ero said it had not received documentation supporting a separate US$1.9 million fish-mortality fine and that it had identified no correlation with Tucumã.

data.title: JPX Approves Provisional Accounts, ¥41 Interim Dividend
data.description:
Japan Exchange Group ( (JP:8697) ) just unveiled an update.

Japan Exchange Group, Inc. (JPX), listed on the TSE Prime market under code 8697, said its board resolved on November 27, 2026, to approve provisional financial statements and an interim dividend from surplus. The provisional settlement covered the period from April 1 to September 30, 2026, and reported operating revenue of ¥69,160 million, operating income of ¥64,595 million, ordinary income of ¥64,803 million and net income of ¥63,701 million.

The settlement was conducted to include the period’s profit in distributable retained earnings. JPX set the interim dividend at ¥41 per share, totaling ¥41,914 million, with payment effective December 1, 2026; the amount was unchanged from its October 27 disclosure and the annual dividend forecast remained unrevised.

data.title: NT Minerals announces share placement agreement and Twin Peaks update
data.description:
Redbank Copper Ltd. ( (AU:NTM) ) has issued an update.

NT Minerals announced plans for a placement of 181,635,437 shares at $0.002 each to raise $363,271 before costs. The stated purpose of the funds is Twin Peaks exploration and working capital.

An office-based review describes Twin Peaks as a multi-commodity opportunity, citing historical VHMS-style copper, zinc, lead, silver and gold intercepts, a conceptual 230-770Mt magnetite target at 20-35% iron, and copper-associated pathfinder elements. NT Minerals cautioned that the historical drill results have not been independently verified and that the exploration target is conceptual and insufficiently explored for a mineral-resource estimate.

data.title: NZ RegCo Grants TruScreen Waiver From Half-Year Results Announcement
data.description:
TruScreen Group Ltd. ( (NZ:TRU) ) has shared an announcement.

NZ RegCo granted TruScreen a waiver from the NZX requirement to release a half-year results announcement for the six months ended 30 September 2026. The decision followed TruScreen’s application to change its balance date; NZ RegCo cited the company’s substantial Asian business, where Chinese New Year and Ramadan create uncertainty around fourth-quarter revenue recognition and operations, and its core subsidiary and employees being based in Australia.

NZ RegCo said requiring a separate half-year announcement could duplicate reporting and confuse investors. TruScreen remains subject to continuous disclosure obligations, including the immediate release of material information to the market.

data.title: Astra Graphia Announces IDR297 Per-Share 2025 Dividend
data.description:
PT Astra Graphia Tbk ( (ID:ASGR) ) has provided an update.

Astra Graphia Tbk announced a cash dividend of IDR400.587.808.500, equivalent to IDR297 per share, for fiscal year 2025. The Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders approved using part of retained earnings as of 31 December 2025 for the distribution, with net profit attributable to the parent entity reported at IDR270.616.498.521.

The dividend payment is scheduled for 11 December 2026, with shareholders recorded by 2 December 2026 at 16:00 eligible for the distribution. Trading dates begin with the cum-dividend date of 30 November 2026 in the regular and negotiation markets, while applicable taxes and payment procedures will vary according to shareholder status and registration arrangements.
